claims: Creatify just shipped an MCP server that 'turns Claude into a full ad agency'
From a product page Claude wrote the script, picked an avatar, rendered the ad; can produce 10 variations for A/B testing and push winners to Meta or TikTok
'Used to be a two-week turnaround and a freelancer invoice'; setup takes ~2 minutes
It remembers brand colours and tone so later ads are faster
On screen: 4 variants render in ~10 min each; 'Credits remaining: 327'
how_to_steps: Claude Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector; name 'Creatify', URL https://api.creatify.ai/mcp (OAuth client id/secret optional)
Create a Claude project and add the product page / product photo as shared context
Prompt: 'make me a 30 second video ad for this product, female avatar, make it feel native to TikTok'
Ask for N variations (different hook/product focus/presenter energy) for A/B testing
Push winning variants to Meta or TikTok
on_screen_only: Product: 'FORD NAVY POLO' shirt photo; prompt text '...a 30 second video ad for this product.' in a Claude project with 'Fable 5 / High'
Connectors list: Slack, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Asana, Boehlis, GitHub integration, Gmail, Google Drive, HubSpot, Jamie, Notion, Onnisend
Add custom connector dialog: Name 'Creatify', URL 'https://api.creatify.ai/mcp', Advanced settings OAuth Client ID / Secret

Creatify tool list: creative_create_session, creative_get_session, creative_send_turn, product_create, product_get, product_get_brand_info, product_list, upload_file_widget, voice_clone, voice_clone_get

Claude response: 'Kicking off 4 variations now, each with the same hook/product focus and format but a distinct presenter energy' and '1. High-energy hype 2. Chill/laid-back 3. Dry/deadpan humour 4. Warm/storytelling', 'All 4 are rendering now (~10 min each)', 'Credits remaining: 327'
Rendered avatar: woman in navy polo in a kitchen

implement_score.why: Two-minute connector setup, but Creatify is credit-based and the demo is clearly sponsored/affiliate; try only when an app is ready for paid ads. Pushing to Meta/TikTok is asserted, not shown
